adaptation.guarantee_scope: finite catalogs and this discrete adaptation; not continuous RL
adaptation.information_pattern: open-loop fixed plan, then finite disturbance history
adaptation.objective: minimize worst terminal squared position gap

parallelotope_method.coordinate_frame: x = Q y; Q is a fixed unit-upper-triangular dyadic shear

timing.input_policy: one immutable request reused; fixture setup is outside timing
timing.interval: complete public algorithm call; request construction and JSON serialization excluded
timing.limiter_profile: not collected: perf and strace are unavailable; descriptive timing only
timing.order_policy: four methods rotate order across each repetition
timing.warm_state_policy: one excluded warmup per method; no algorithm workspace reused
